title: Governed memory admission policy
description: The AUTHORITATIVE side of the admission vocabulary. The Rust MemoryRefusalCode enum is checked against this set, never against a count: a rename preserves a count. The ORDER of checks is part of the policy, not an implementation detail -- an opt-in check that runs after the first boundary touch is legal, invisible, and already past the boundary it exists to hold.

orderedChecks.description: Evaluated top to bottom. The first entry runs BEFORE any boundary is touched.

refusalCodes.description: The closed set. A code needed by a consuming lane is allocated HERE, never minted downstream.

runsBeforeFirstTouch.description: True only for checks that must complete before a candidate, provider, log, event, or persistent boundary is touched.
